vocabulary_focus.concept: Let me know / Keep me updated

expressions.en: Let me know / Keep me updated
expressions.cn: 告诉我 (gàosù wǒ) / 让我知道 (ràng wǒ zhīdào)
expressions.bm_formal: Sila maklumkan saya / Beri saya maklum balas
expressions.bm_casual: Bagitahu saya / Inform saya / Update saya

vocabulary_focus.concept: I will follow up / I'll check on it

expressions.en: I will follow up / I'll check on it
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan susulan / Saya akan semak
expressions.bm_casual: Saya akan follow up / Nanti saya check

expressions.en: Could you please elaborate? / Can you explain more?
expressions.cn: 你能详细说明一下吗？(nǐ néng xiángxì shuōmíng yīxià ma?)
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh tuan/puan huraikan dengan lebih lanjut? / Mohon penjelasan lebih terperinci.
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh explain lagi? / Boleh cerita lagi detail?

expressions.en: Thank you for your cooperation / Thanks for helping
expressions.cn: 谢谢您的合作 (xièxie nín de hézuò)
expressions.bm_casual: Terima kasih banyak-banyak / Thanks for the help / Terima kasih atas bantuan.

work.scenario: You're in a team meeting discussing a new project deadline. Your manager asks for an update on a specific task you're responsible for.
key_phrases: Sila maklumkan saya jika ada perubahan.

life.scenario: You're planning a family dinner with your relatives. You need to confirm the date and time with your aunt.
key_phrases: Faham, nanti saya bagitahu yang lain.

tech.scenario: You're troubleshooting a software bug with a colleague from the IT department. You need to understand the steps they took and ask for updates.
key_phrases: Boleh explain lagi tentang masalah ni?
